rationale: No supported optimization's preconditions are met for this workflow. The workflow already cancels in-progress or superseded runs for the same ref via concurrency (group: ${{ github.ref }}-${{ github.workflow }}, cancel-in-progress: true), which partitions cancellation by workflow and branch, so P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is already satisfied. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is not applicable because the workflow has no dependency-installation step (only checkout plus the MegaLinter container action), so there is no repeated dependency fetching to measure or cache and nothing to restore. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST requires a matrix, which this single-job workflow lacks. Schedule-based patterns (P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE, P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE) do not apply because there is no schedule trigger. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT and P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT require representative successful-duration history, but ci_history reports no completed runs. P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER is contraindicated: this is a monorepo whose apps share workspace configuration (eslint-config-sheriff, pnpm workspaces), so path-based filtering could skip required checks triggered by shared-config changes. Job reordering/prioritization/selection patterns (P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST, P-LIT-PRIORITIZE, P-LIT-SELECT, P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT) are ci_service/build_configuration scoped and do not map to this single lint job. Applying any of these would be a no-op, could weaken required-check coverage, or add unsupported behavior, so no change is made.
